subject: Welcome to Redwood — QuickCheck: 15min Hosted API intro
messages:
From: Redwood Signup <no-reply@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@shopglyph.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for signing up — QuickCheck to get you started

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Hosted API evaluation — we’ve provisioned a tenant and given you a small sandbox credit to try out quick generation and embeddings. If you’d like help getting a fast look at latency/cost tradeoffs and a short walkthrough of the sandbox, we offer a 15-minute QuickCheck with an SDR or solutions engineer.

Pick a 15-minute slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-quickcheck

What we typically cover in 15 minutes:
- Quick sandbox access and credentials
- Sample prompts for typical PLG flows (onboarding, search, chat)
- How to interpret latency/cost in the Console

No obligation — just a quick run to make sure the sandbox is useful. I’ve cc’d Sean from our SDR team who can schedule and share prework if you want to confirm a time.

— Redwood Onboarding
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@shopglyph.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — QuickCheck to get you started

Hey Alex — welcome and thanks for signing up. I’m Sean on the SDR team. Quick availability below (PDT):

- Fri Apr 11 — 11:30am or 3:00pm
- Mon Apr 14 — 9:00am or 2:15pm

If any of those work, I’ll lock a 15-minute invite and drop sandbox creds + a 1-page preflight checklist. Otherwise you can grab a slot directly at the Calendly link above.

Quick note: if you want a slightly deeper 30-min session to also look at embedding demos, let me know and I’ll route to our solutions engineer.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Sean Gallagher
SDR, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex@shopglyph.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Team ShopGlyph <salesops@shopglyph.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for signing up — QuickCheck to get you started

Thanks Sean — appreciate the quick reach out. 11:30am today would be perfect, but could we shift to 12:00pm (30 minutes later)? I have a standing meeting that often runs over.

Also: we’re primarily interested in embeddings for similarity search and a lightweight chat assistant for onboarding flows. If whoever joins can show a quick embedding example and a short chat latency check that’d be ideal.

— Alex
Alex Rivera

Hi Alex — Mina from Sales Ops here. Confirmed: I’ve moved the session to today, Apr 11, 12:00pm–12:15pm PDT and sent a calendar invite to you and your team.

Attached is a small credentials stub so you can pre-check sandbox access before the call: --- Attachment: shopglyph-sandbox-creds.txt (text/plain) ---

- Try the echo generation sample in the sandbox to confirm the token billing appears in the Console
- If you want embeddings precomputed, reply with a small sample CSV and we’ll pre-load 10 rows for the demo

On the call: Sean will walk the QuickCheck; Neha (solutions) will join if we need a 30-min deep dive on embeddings. If you want Neha on the 15-min slot now, let me know and we’ll extend to 30.

Invite: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-quickcheck (used for booking and rescheduling)
